I was pleased to be able to buy a reasonably priced filter.  Unfortunately, even though it looks exactly the same as the original filter that came with my Samsung refrigerator and the water tastes great from the dispenser, the filter does not have a good seal and has a slow leak when water runs through it. After a couple of days of normal use in a four person household, there was a pool of water on the top shelf.  I currently have to use some of the space on the top shelf to put a plastic container under the filter to catch the dripping water.  Luckily it is a slow enough leak that I do not have to empty the plastic container once every week to week and a half.

After buying the Samsung OEM filter for the past several years, I saw a big jump in price.  So, I started reviewing the options, and reading the product reviews.  I noticed numerous recent bad reviews of the Samsung filter, saying that it no longer fit my Samsung refrigerator model without carving pieces of plastic.  Did not want to do that, and I found the Waterdrop model getting consistently good reviews, and available at far less.  Figured I would try it.  Ordered it, it came on time, and it installed easily!  Wish I could tell you the water tastes better, but I'm not sure.  I think it tastes just fine, and, equally important, I think I am getting even better water flow with this filter than I got before.  As a result, happy to recommend the Waterdrop filter.
